headline: Debate on housing crisis in Spain between Sánchez and Feijóo
summary: The housing crisis, which triggered an early election after Congress rejected two government decrees, dominated the only face-to-face debate between Pedro Sánchez and Alberto Núñez Feijóo.
why: Housing policy and election outcomes in Spain, the euro area's fourth-largest economy, affect fiscal plans, real estate markets and investor sentiment toward Spanish assets.
original_headline: Debate sobre crisis vivienda en España entre Sánchez y Feijóo
